08364 Shuthalchiy {shoo-thal-kee'}

源自 07803 的種族名稱; 形容詞

AV - Shuthalhites 1; 1

書提拉族 = 見 書提拉 "新任命"
1) 以法蓮的兒子書提拉及同名子孫的後裔 (#民 26:35|)

patronymically from 07803;; adj

AV - Shuthalhites 1; 1

Shuthalhites = see Shuthelah "freshly appointed"
1) descendants of Shuthelah, son of Ephraim, and of his son of the
